inspiration.observed_pattern: CONVERT_TZ converts a datetime string from a numeric source offset to UTC.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one fixed datetime and two numeric timezone offsets, removing JSON extraction, regular-expression cleanup, tables, and unrelated projections so the CONVERT_TZ contract is isolated.

fixture_notes: One fixed wall time at +02:00 must become 09:30 UTC with DATETIME metadata.
determinism_notes: All literals are fixed; the scalar projection has no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
